branches.label: Network equivalent (not a mapped line): 47 kV Follo trafostasjon – Lambertseter trafostasjon, 2 × 16 km

provenance.note: equivalent of out-of-scope sub-transmission (47 kV, below the model's 132 kV floor), not a mapped line: Elvia's 47 kV network shares Oslo south and north Nordre Follo between Statnett's Follo 420/47 kV station and Elvia's Lambertseter 132/47 kV station: NVE Nettanlegg4 maps two 47 kV circuits over the 16.0 km route Follo – Myrvoll – Tårnlia – Prinsdal – Klemetsrud – Lambertseter. The ≥132 kV model would otherwise feed the area's whole demand at Lambertseter through its one 132 kV cable. Statnett and Elvia name Follo as one of the stations supplying Oslo south and Follo, with little transformation margin left, which is why Liåsen 420/132 kV is being built. Conductors, transformer ratings and the normal switching state of the 47 kV network are not published; the equivalent assumes both circuits closed. Impedance and rating by rule sub-transmission-equivalent (sub-transmission-equivalent, overhead-rating-at-0c, transformer-capacity-matched, emergency-120pct-15min), with 150 MVA transformation at each end.

The 300 kV Jostedal – Leirdøla line ends at node 5287283393, where NVE places the Jostedal station, 1.27 km from the outline of the underground Jostedal plant; OSM maps no station there. Electrical values by rules overhead-300kv, overhead-rating-at-0c, emergency-120pct-15min.

The 300 kV line from Modalen ends at node 5311382733 by the underground Nygard pumped-storage plant, 162 m outside the mapped plant outline, so open data leaves the plant without a grid terminal. Electrical values by rules overhead-300kv, overhead-rating-at-0c, emergency-120pct-15min.

The 132 kV line from Ertsmyra to Tonstad wind farm ends at node 6838321590, 54 m outside the mapped outline of the farm's indoor 33/132 kV substation, so open data leaves the farm without a grid terminal; the model then attached its 208 MW at Buheii, 14 km away, and loaded Buheii – Tonstad with both farms. The concession gives the farm its own 33/132 kV substation and a 15 km 132 kV line to Ertsmyra (verified). Electrical values by rules overhead-132kv, overhead-rating-at-0c, emergency-120pct-15min.
